name: assignment-proposal-not-assignable
purpose: A reviewer cannot be assigned to a proposal that has not been confirmed eligible (AssignmentValidity: the proposal is assignable).

given.text: Quorum is running with a published call, an officer, a chair, applicants and verified reviewers
proposal p1 has reached submitted and is still in screening

when.text: the officer assigns verified reviewer 0 to p1

then.text: the assignment is refused as not_assignable
